content:
BUILT CoLAB celebrated its fifth anniversary on 19 September!

With this in mind, it brought together employees and associates to take stock of the past year and present current and future projects that will enable us to continue on our path as a Collaborative Laboratory towards the Digital and Sustainable Transition of the AEC Sector.

After a social lunch, the afternoon was devoted to a team-building activity focused on the more personal side of the team, which provided an opportunity for everyone to socialise and consolidate their mutual knowledge.
